name: Página de agendamento carrega com serviços
description: Visitante acessa a página de agendamento e vê os serviços disponíveis para seleção

planSteps.description: Verify the page shows a list or selection of available barber services with their names and prices
Click on one of the available services to select it
Verify that after selecting a service, the next step (date/time selection) becomes visible or the selected service is highlighted
